items.title: 2nd place - ILAN University Innovation Awards 2026
items.blurb: Sentinel uses computer vision to detect safety risks in industrial environments.
body: Sentinel took second place at the ILAN University Innovation Awards. It is a computer vision system designed to improve safety in factories and industrial environments by detecting risks and helping prevent workplace accidents.
Associated with Universidad de San Carlos de Guatemala.

items.title: 2nd place - Cursor × Tec Hackathon Guatemala
items.blurb: In four hours, we turned a phone into an AR telescope that tracks the ISS and Hubble.
body: Ranked in the top 2 of roughly 10 teams at Cursor Hackathon Guatemala, a 4-hour build sprint, for El Telescopio Digital (Sextant), a browser-based AR experience that turns a phone into a live sky telescope.

In a single afternoon, we shipped a production web demo that tracks the ISS and Hubble in real time using SGP4 orbital propagation and NASA/NORAD TLE data. The demo runs entirely in the browser and uses the phone’s camera, gyroscope, and GPS.
The challenge was to take an idea from concept to an interactive product that anyone could try before the four hours were up.

items.title: Travel Grant — Cursor Buildathon San Salvador
items.blurb: Travel grant to represent Guatemala at a 24 h AI-first buildathon.
body: Travel grant from the502project for the Cursor Buildathon in San Salvador.
Selected to represent the local community and build with AI-assisted tools under time pressure (Shoot AI).

items.title: Hackathon SemiFinalist — INNOVATECH 2026
items.blurb: Q-Pay (Qubity): P2P lending; 100+ waitlist in under a week.
body: Semifinalists with Q-Pay: a P2P lending app aimed at cutting friction around promissory notes (with Qubity).
Fast demand signal: 100+ waitlist in under a week, also competing against local startups.

items.title: 1st Place - UFM Computer Science Hackatón
items.blurb: Aprendi adapts each student’s learning path to their performance in real time.
body: Our team at Qubity designed and built Aprendi, an adaptive learning platform with intelligent user workflows, securing 1st place in the competition.
Developed during an intensive sprint, the platform delivers personalized educational paths by dynamically adjusting content based on real-time student performance. It includes interactive Linux labs.
This recognition highlighted our technical execution, system architecture, and the potential to scale AI-driven education tools.

items.title: Hackathon Finalist (Top 5) — Atom Dev Day
items.blurb: Top 5 in ~8–12 h with Agent Builder: sales agents with LLM + RAG.
body: Top 5 at Atom Dev Day (~8–12 h) with Agent Builder: a platform to assemble sales agents with LLM + RAG.
Proof of execution under pressure: idea to usable demo in a single sprint.

items.title: Guatemala Honorific Mention — Global Connection Award
items.blurb: Global Connection mention for Guatemala; deliverable: Astro Tracker (48 h MVP).
body: Honorific mention (Global Connection) for Guatemala at the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
Deliverable: Astro Tracker — asteroid-impact simulation with NASA data, built as a 48-hour MVP.

items.title: Leadership Award
items.blurb: Full scholarship to an intensive leadership program for academic excellence.
body: Full scholarship to an intensive leadership program for outstanding academics and a top-tier GPA.
Selected for initiative, peer influence, and commitment to technical work and community during technical high school.
